currentState: Concept reset; no current production-authoritative issue. This is the correct time to rebuild the course around source documents.
issueCountPolicy: Academy course architecture: default one issue; use two or three only if the source material and dramatic form genuinely require additional room. Three total issues is the expected maximum. Legacy multi-module plans are content pools, not issue assignments.

sourceFamilies.name: Shattered Accord text/history
sourceFamilies.status: foundational target source; exact operative text/edition must be located and reconciled before verbatim adaptation
sourceFamilies.use: Treaty language, procedures, omissions, compromises, and later interpretations.

narrationMethod: Let oral-history voices and documentary text carry part of the narration across reconstructions. The Academy class should compare versions, provenance, omissions, and consequences rather than receive one omniscient history lecture.
historicalScope: Liora Virelia and the BHA/High Era belong near the beginning; the Shattered Accord belongs near the culmination. Present-day Venn/Dominion references may show inheritance but are not the historical center.

productionIsolation.cast: course-local by default; cross-course reuse must be explicit
productionIsolation.imgProject: dedicated course IMG/reference project when visual production begins
productionIsolation.gitWorkflow: develop on a course-specific feature branch when useful, then merge approved state to main; do not treat a long-lived branch as separate canon
